title: Portal and Sector Travel (launch, corridor, cancel)
description:
Purpose: Activate mission portals from the Launch Platform, transition to Sector Travel Corridor mini-scene with optional target practice, mask loading, and support emergency cancel via B returning to Oa.

Controls:
- Interact (A) on gate console to confirm mission travel.
- B Button: Cancel and return to Launch Platform from corridor.

Behaviour:
1) At launch_platform, listen for mission selection (from mission_system); enable portal VFX (sector_travel_corridor_vfx) and show mission name.
2) On confirmation, fade world, load corridor scene, optionally spawn practice drones via builtin.spawner with a max-alive cap.
3) In corridor, allow immediate return on B: cancel travel, unload corridor, restore to launch platform (satisfies test_portal_cancel_return).
4) On arrival, hand off to mission scene.

Components:
- Reads: mission_system queue, inputs.
- Writes: scene transitions, VFX toggles, spawners.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_mission_selection_flow, test_portal_cancel_return.

Integration and depends_on:
- Depends on mission_system; registers a portal status UI chip via hud_and_wrist_menu.

Assets/scenes:
- launch_platform_gate, sector_travel_corridor_vfx.

Suggested file split: portal_register.cpp, portal_runtime.cpp, portal_practice_spawner.cpp.
